settlement_source: Governing League = PGA Tour (pgatour.com); ACHIEVEMENTS terms name the governing league, AP, ESPN, WSJ, Fox Sports as Source Agencies. Expiration Value as documented at 10:00 AM ET on Expiration Date.
settlement_variable: Sole/tied leader on leaderboard at end of Round 2 of the named tournament (e.g. 2026 VidantaWorld Mexico Open); official result per Source Agency.
timezone: ET for expiration (10:00 AM ET); tournament local time otherwise
tie_handling: Per market rules_secondary: tie for lead pays Yes $1/N rounded down to cent, No = 1 - Yes.
rounding: Yes payout $1/N rounded DOWN to nearest cent
trading_close_vs_settlement: close_time = expiration_time = 2026-11-15T00:00Z (sample) but can_close_early=1, settlement_timer 60s; Round 2 ends earlier so market can settle once R2 completes. Exact close vs round end: unknown.
early_close_or_void_clauses: Postponed final event: open until result or 2 weeks after scheduled date (generic ACHIEVEMENTS text written for tournament winner)
Cancellation: last traded price / Outcome Review Committee / equal split among eligible
Kalshi may initiate Market Outcome Review (Rule 6.3(d)); post-expiration revisions ignored
title_vs_rules_divergences: Terms (ACHIEVEMENTS.pdf) are generic for official final result of an achievement; Round-2-leader specifics (suspended/unfinished round, cut timing) not defined = unknown
Withdrawal -> No may conflict with a player who led after R2 then WD'd
